name: OnMyWay
background: Collaborated with a six-person team to build OnMyWay, an ride-hailing Android app for a course project. The app explored the full ride flow from rider requests to driver acceptance, with Firebase-backed account data, Google Maps route views, and a QR code based payment concept. The project emphasized Agile planning and featured iterative design artifacts, automated unit/instrumentation tests with JUnit + Robotium, and comprehensive documentation powered by Javadocs.
